title: A mayor’s digital twin.
An invitation from a city.
paragraphs: On March 10, 2026, Tainan arrived at the Tokyo food exhibition. With buyers visiting from different countries, how could more people connect with its local produce and the stories behind it?

tAistro brought an AI digital twin of Tainan Mayor Huang Wei-che to the exhibition through digital-human technology and hardware–software integration. Guidance in Mandarin, Japanese, English and Korean opened a new way to interact with visitors.

facts: Enterprise knowledge management with traceable sources
Hosted by the Bureau of Economic Development, Tainan City Government

title: Company knowledge,
shared team capability.
paragraphs: The 2026 Tainan Technology Industry Forum and Exhibition, hosted by the Bureau of Economic Development, Tainan City Government, ran on 16–17 September 2026 at ICC Tainan. Two days of talks and showcases focused on applied AI and green energy.

tAistro presented Synaiq KIP around everyday knowledge management needs: scattered documents, time spent searching, and experience that is difficult to pass on. Synaiq KIP connects document ingestion, parsing, and library management, so teams can ask questions in natural language and follow citations back to the original material.

tAistro also joined the forum panel. Our contribution focused on enterprise knowledge management: organizing documents and experience into knowledge that can be searched, traced, and maintained to support daily work and knowledge transfer.

title: From stored information
to shared knowledge.
field.intro: Synaiq KIP focuses on knowledge management within the enterprise. Document integration, search, and source verification help teams find, understand, and reuse what their organization knows.
notes: Connect scattered documents to the knowledge center, then parse and organize them into libraries that provide a shared foundation for the team.
Check every answer against its source
Ask for work information in natural language. Citations lead back to the original material so people can verify the answer and its context.
Maintain procedures and records of experience in a knowledge base that supports collaboration, onboarding, and handovers.
